sources.title: HTMX + Alpine.js: 35KB Interactive UIs, Zero Build Step
sources.keyClaim: HTMX+Alpine totals 31KB gzipped vs React's 200-500KB. No build step. 40-60% faster first-load for CRUD apps.

sources.title: Javascript Fatigue: HTMX Is All You Need to Build ChatGPT — Part 2
sources.keyClaim: Complete ChatGPT clone with HTMX SSE streaming in <200 LoC. Session-based architecture with asyncio.Queue.

sources.title: Laravel AI Streaming UX: Typing Indicators, Thought States, and Stream Cancellation
sources.keyClaim: Production Alpine.js state machine for LLM streaming: idle→thinking→streaming→complete→cancelled with RAF buffering and cancel support.

sources.title: HTMX + Alpine.js + SSE Interactive Components Guide
sources.keyClaim: Complete component library: modals, drawers, toasts, SSE, theme toggle. Go/Templ backend. Production-ready patterns.

sources.title: HTMX Chatbot Tutorial (FastAPI)
sources.keyClaim: Step-by-step HTMX chat with SSE streaming, SQLite persistence, sidebar+threads. 7 progressive steps.

sources.title: Django AI Chat with Ollama and HTMX
sources.keyClaim: Django + HTMX + SSE chat with local LLM via Ollama. Markdown support, conversation history.

sources.title: HTMX vs React 2026: 14KB vs 47KB — When Each Wins
sources.keyClaim: HTMX 14KB vs React 47KB base. HTMX wins initial load, React wins complex interactivity. They coexist.

sources.title: Hybrid HTMX + Minimal JS in Django 2026
sources.keyClaim: Three real migrations: 76% faster TTI, 53-59% code reduction, 47-55% velocity gains. Rule: if state lives in DB, HTMX owns it.

sources.title: htmx vs React in 2026: When I Actually Reach For htmx
sources.keyClaim: If page is a live editor, chat surface, or canvas with lots of client state, keep using React. HTMX for forms+lists.

sources.title: Is HTMX the Future of Web Dev? A React vs. HTMX Benchmark
sources.keyClaim: HTMX FCP 0.8s vs React 1.2s; TTI 1.1s vs 2.3s; memory 24MB vs 56MB. React wins post-creation latency.

sources.title: HTMX and Alpine.js: How to combine two great, lean front ends
sources.keyClaim: HTMX for server communication, Alpine.js for client-side reactivity. Complementary, not competing.

sources.title: HTMX vs React — Performance and Architecture Deep-Dive
sources.keyClaim: HTMX 14KB vs React 42KB base. HTMX wins initial load on slow networks. React wins complex interactivity.

sources.title: Building a Modern Web App with HTMX + AlpineJS
sources.keyClaim: HTMX+Alpine for content-heavy apps, CRUD, internal tools. Consider alternatives for complex state, real-time, mobile.

sources.title: Building a Live Comment Stream with SSE
sources.keyClaim: FastAPI + HTMX + Alpine.js + Tailwind SSE comment stream. SSE ideal for server→client streaming.

sources.title: Streaming AI with htmx
sources.keyClaim: Go + Templ + HTMX SSE streaming. SplitData for HTML fragments. Clean separation of streaming and completion.

sources.title: Quart, HTMX, and Server Sent Events
sources.keyClaim: Quart + HTMX SSE chat. ConnectedClients class for managing multiple SSE connections.

sources.title: Real-Time Updates with Server Events and Predictable Client Reconciliation
sources.keyClaim: SSE reconciliation: event-as-invalidation pattern, editing locks, dirty state tracking, reconnect recovery.

sources.title: The Server Sent Events Extension
sources.keyClaim: HTMX SSE extension: sse-connect, sse-swap, hx-trigger=sse:event. Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff.
